Geneva Tax Advisor 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Step-by-step guidance for Geneva (Switzerland) tax returns using GeTax software.
- Covers all tax sections: salary, deductibles (professional, pillar 3a/3b, medical, insurance, donations), real estate, securities, foreign property, bank accounts, debts, and cryptocurrency.
- Details critical Geneva-specific rules (e.g. ICC meal deduction, source tax, DA-1/RSI, foreign property progression, medical expense thresholds).
- Explains deduction optimization, including forfaitaire vs effectifs for various expense types.
- Emphasizes always referencing official GeTax guides and avoiding guesswork on tax fields.
- Includes summary of future optimization tips and detailed reference file usage.
